command: python3 scripts/verify_staged.py start; synchronous next batches; then finish. Exact invocations and compiler argv are recorded in process_record.json and RESULTS.json.
mathematical_claim: In every model of encoded ZFC, the original guard makes internal small-union closure equivalent to internal small-product closure. Under guard and internal complete-filter extension, the internal fine-ultrafilter principle is equivalent to those closure predicates. The cone filter and its completeness/fineness are constructed internally with explicit closure premises. These reductions are actual closed membership-language sentences. The small-product premise and the original forward implication are fully discharged for concrete ZFSet only, not arbitrary models.
input_domain: Arbitrary membership structures satisfying encoded ZFC; internal set-coded injection witnesses, function graphs, relation tables, scopes, ultrafilters and completeness. No external-cardinality or powerset correctness assumption.
tested_surrogate: Fresh proof elaboration, exhaustive named theorem axiom audit, predecessor source equality, expected rejection controls. Mathematical universal conclusions derive from the proof terms, not from finite enumeration.

bounds.build_strategy: Clean serial targets in hash-pinned resumable batches

pass_means: Every compilation succeeds, every named theorem is audited, axiom dependencies satisfy the standard allowlist, input hashes are unchanged, predecessor theorem sources match, and false proof and placeholder controls are rejected for the expected reasons.
failure_means: No final PASS or claim that all proofs checked. Compiler, audit, integrity or resource failures must be reported separately.
non_claims: No uncountable compactness cardinal, truth of Theta or KZFC model is proved to exist or introduced as an axiom.
